## Outline

- (20m) querychat
  - Ask questions about your data in natural language, then inspect the SQL that querychat writes
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/26_querychat`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/26_querychat): explore the airbnb data in the built-in querychat app, inspect the SQL, and restart the app with a data dictionary
  - Demo [`_demos/27_querychat`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_demos/27_querychat): a Shiny dashboard built around querychat

- (40m) shinychat
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/24_shinychat-1`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/24_shinychat-1): put the Blockbuster renewal agent in a `page_chat()` app and add a greeting with suggestion cards
  - Your Turn [`_exercises/25_shinychat-2`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_exercises/25_shinychat-2): connect the agent to a drafts drawer with `show_letter()`, then edit a saved draft
  - Discussion: did the agent read the current draft before editing your saved change?
